note: Prototype — internal. Live daily menu data for New York, New Jersey, Illinois, Missouri and Ohio: every store marked in stock was confirmed listing Lowell on today's snapshot, at the price its own menu is quoting the shopper — the retail shelf price, discounts included, never our wholesale. Stores sourced from partner reports carry no price at all, because what we hold for those is what we charged the retailer, which is not what the shopper pays. Dashed pins are stores we ship that no menu feed covers — the products shown are what we sent them. Grey pins are partner-reported: Colorado and New Mexico from Vireo's July retail report — Vireo sells Lowell only through its own banners, so that is the complete fleet. Those locations are placed by city, not by verified street address. California is partial. We ship 61 doors there since June — current data, not stale — but the sales records carry store names and no addresses, so only 14 could be placed on a map with any confidence. The other 47 are real customers we simply can't put a pin on yet. Phone numbers cover 138 stores and come from the existing lowellherbco.com locator. Opening hours are in none of our sources.
